trackformer11.source: NOAA NOMADS GFS 0.25 degree f000 analysis only

intensity_model.model: Trackformer1.1 residual-anchor spatial ensemble used as the Trackformer1.1 intensity head
intensity_model.field_contract: 4x17x17 analysis patch, q/31.75 then clipped to [-4,4]
intensity_model.ensemble_spread: standard deviation across the three frozen spatial experts
intensity_model.structure_calibration: lead- and component-wise validation blend with observed current RMW/radii when available
intensity_model.temporal_wind_branch_policy: same-storm t-12/t-24 analysis patches; wind only; enabled above the validation-selected current-wind gate; base pressure calibration retained
intensity_model.pressure_anchor_policy: validation-fitted blend with valid observed current pressure; no blend when current pressure is missing
intensity_model.track_input_policy: per-feature 0.1%-99.9% bounds from train split only

pressure_map_coupling.method: causal forecast pressure-map query plus confidence-weighted local-minimum/anomaly-radius coupling
pressure_map_coupling.minimum_confidence: local minimum contribution decays directly with route-to-minimum confidence; untrusted minima have near-zero central-intensity weight
pressure_map_coupling.pressure_recovery_limit_source: training-split 90th percentile of positive six-hour pressure changes
pressure_map_coupling.wind_pressure_anchor: observed current wind/pressure; map drives only future changes
pressure_map_coupling.radius_method: learned radius baseline rescaled by trusted local quadrant pressure-anomaly extent; max four-degree footprint

causality.enforcement: every input above was checked against the issue time before use; a later-valid input raises CausalityError and the storm falls back
